desc:
It may seem easy, but can you reach the end? 

🏆 Can you get every ending in the game? Think outside the box and explore the world to find out how many secrets are waiting to be found! Try everything!

🏆 Ending badges will only be given an icon once 1,000 people have obtained it.

🏆 There are currently 99 endings to find. 

⚠️ Some endings are temporarily disabled and will be added as soon as they are rescripted! I'm currently rescripting the entire game!
